chunks.name: Intro
chunks.text: {starts immediately on beat 1: plucked hook, soft kick and sub bass only, sparse, no hats yet}

chunks.name: Groove A
chunks.text: {bass opens on beat 1, hats and a light clap join, bouncy}

chunks.name: Groove B
chunks.text: {full groove on beat 1, bell arpeggio answers the hook, steady and playful}

chunks.name: Breakdown
chunks.text: {everything drops out on beat 1 except the plucked hook and a soft pad, quiet and intimate, no kick, no bass}

chunks.name: Build
chunks.text: {kick returns on beat 1, arpeggio climbs, snare roll builds, filter sweeps up, the last half bar is total silence}

chunks.name: Drop
chunks.text: {huge drop on beat 1 after the silence: full band, four-on-the-floor kick, big sub bass, the hook played big, the loudest part of the track}

chunks.name: Brand
chunks.text: {half-time, bouncy staccato plucks call and answer, rising into the final hit}

chunks.name: Button
chunks.text: {one big unison hit on beat 1 with sub, then let it ring out, no more drums}
